snippet: A detailed news report analyzing the findings of Fabio Giglietto's study on Meta's algorithmic filtering. The piece describes how mainstream institutional politicians lost substantial social media visibility while extremist profiles saw gains, leading major Italian political parties to seek bipartisan legislative solutions to regulate platform transparency.
